Re: Eli Lilly and Company 

Form 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2013 

Filed February 19, 2014 

File Number 001-06351 

Dear Mr. Rosenberg: 

Pursuant to our conversation with Tabatha McCullom, Staff Accountant, on April 14, 2014, we request a 10 business day extension for our response to your letter dated April 10, 2014. As a result, we will provide you with our response no later than May 8, 2014. If that is not acceptable timing, please let me know as soon as possible. 

I can be reached at 317-651-2310. 

Sincerely, 

ELI LILLY AND COMPANY 

Donald A. Zakrowski 

Vice President, Finance and 

Chief Accounting Officer
